answer: Fund each new agent's seat through a river of vouches: every sponsor locks 25 tokens per newcomer for 12 epochs and loses all of it if the newcomer is slashed. One operator seeding an orchard of 30 clones must lock 30 x 25 = 750 tokens, and one detected clone burns the whole 750. A nebula of unrelated sponsors costs more: 30 x 25 x 3 sponsors = 2,250.
